title: Letting git find the commit that broke a check

narration.text: Eight commits. The check passes at the oldest one and fails at the tip, and nobody knows which commit did it.
Hand git both ends of the range. The order they go in catches people out, so read it off the screen rather than guessing.
Now let it run the check itself. Watch it step over a revision it cannot judge: the script reports that case apart from passing and failing, and git treats it accordingly.
And let go when it is done, or you are left parked on a detached revision with the search still open.
Back on the branch, clean, nothing in progress.

notes: A different helper and eight commits; the task's repository, verdict script and subjects all differ.
